name: Goodman Youth Arts Council (GYAC)
what_you_do: CPS students use theater to talk about issues that young people face. They plan and run events by teens for teens. They learn from Goodman artists and staff, and they act as ambassadors for the theater.
who_can_apply: Chicago Public Schools students in grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: Travel stipends available. No wages stated.
duration: Meets every other Wednesday, 4:30 to 6:30 p.m., at the Goodman (2025/26 schedule began Nov 5)
deadline_text: Applications for 2025/26 are closed. 2026/27 dates not posted on the page read.
how_to_apply: Write to the Goodman and ask about the next application. The email is Education@GoodmanTheatre.org.
notes: The page still shows the 2025/26 school year, so confirm the 2026/27 plan with the Goodman. Meetings are at 170 N. Dearborn St.
